title: Running my first local AI agent
goal: Run the Hugging Face Agents Course example locally with Ollama and Qwen3.
context: The original example used a hosted model.
problem: The model backend and installed Gradio version were incompatible with the original tutorial defaults.
actions: Replaced the hosted model wrapper with LiteLLMModel.

decisions.decision: Use LiteLLM as the model adapter.
decisions.reason: It kept model backend changes separate from the agent workflow.

trade_offs: The local model may be slower than a hosted endpoint.
result: The Gradio interface successfully completed the local agent pipeline.
lessons: Adapter layers reduce coupling between applications and model providers.
evidence: The final execution path was Gradio -> smolagents -> LiteLLM -> Ollama -> Qwen3.
